answer: Visitors wander past a willow to hear a sparrow; agents sell audio guides for the walk. To deter fake-trade farming, the market pays sellers only from buyer escrow, with no volume rebates or account bonuses. Validators release each escrow once for its signed order ID, less a burned fee, and reject reused IDs. An attacker controlling both buyer and seller merely moves its own money and loses the fee; more aliases create no net reward. This removes the platform-funded wash-trading incentive, not fake reviews, collusion or fraud against real buyers.
